overview: Introduce a minimal in-repo WDK runtime and worker (workflow controller + durable steps) and cut over document ingest to WDK behind a short-lived feature flag. Quick Start cutover is tracked separately in refactor 0004.
goals: WDK runtime exists in-repo with a clear minimal API surface and conventions (use workflow / use step).
WDK worker loop is runnable via pnpm --filter @legaltech-poc/web worker.
Step claiming is safe for multiple workers (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED).
Document ingest is WDK-owned (no new jobs(type=ingest_document) rows) once the cutover is rolled forward.
nonGoals: Implement retrieval substrate (0011a) or Matter Chat (0011b).
Refactor Quick Start internals into retrieve/draft/lock/verify/write in this dossier.
successMetrics: wdk_smoke completes across worker restarts without duplicate side effects.
With cutover enabled, uploads ingest via WDK and do not create ingest jobs.
openQuestions: Does WDK world reuse run_steps directly or use WDK-specific step rows first?
What minimal dev-only debug surface is required (/spikes/wdk/* vs DB-only inspection)?

stack.hosting: Hetzner VM (target posture; local dev supported)

routes.name: Start WDK smoke
routes.purpose: Dev-only trigger to start the WDK smoke workflow (implementation detail; may vary).

uiNotes: No user-facing UI required in this refactor; minimal dev-only trigger endpoint is acceptable.

stories.title: Execute WDK smoke workflow durably
stories.description: As a developer, I want a WDK worker that can run a tiny smoke workflow across restarts so the runtime is proven before cutting over real work.
acceptanceCriteria: A dev-only mechanism exists to start wdk_smoke and observe durable step state.
Example: kill and restart the worker mid-flight and the workflow completes without duplicate side effects.
Negative: workflow does not execute step side effects inside the HTTP handler.

stories.title: Feature-flag ingest cutover to WDK
stories.description: As a developer, I want ingest to execute via WDK behind a short-lived feature flag so we can roll forward safely and roll back without schema rollback.
acceptanceCriteria: A single env flag gates ingest orchestration path (jobs vs WDK).
Example: with flag ON, uploads ingest via WDK and do not create jobs(type=ingest_document) rows.
Negative: with flag OFF, ingest continues to work without requiring a WDK worker.
